{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Out of Curiosity Banner.png |location =[[Shoreline]] |given by =[[Therapist]] |reward = |reputation = |time limit = |quest number = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Good afternoon. It is obvious that in the current difficult situation, everyone who has medical knowledge is worth gold, not to mention actual working doctors. And it looks like such a doctor has appeared. I was told that someone on the Shoreline is treating the locals and selling them medicine. I have hired several groups to go there. They had to find this doctor, enter into negotiations and offer the best terms. But today, none of the groups got in touch. We need these medications, I've got clients... ahem, people in need to worry about. Find my people and find out what happened.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 21 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate the group that was sent to the Health Resort on [[Shoreline]] * Locate the group that was sent to the pier on [[Shoreline]] * Locate the group that was sent to the cottages on [[Shoreline]] * Survive and extract from the location ==Rewards== * +12,300 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.04''' * 45,000 Roubles ** 47,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 51,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[SJ1 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]] * 2× [[SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]] {{quote|All three groups wiped out? I don't understand how this could happen. They were not supposed to attract attention and get involved in a fight. They were negotiators with a very lucrative trade offer. Looks like the negotiations went horribly wrong.}} ==Guide== Locate the three bodies of the people [[Therapist]] hired on [[Shoreline]]. These corpses will be covered with white shrouds. All three corpses must be found in a single raid. If you leave the raid and have only found some of the corpses, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found all the corpses. The three corpses can be found in the following locations:
